title: "East Data, West Computing" project and national integrated computing network
title_original: “东数西算”工程 / 全国一体化算力网
summary: National computing infrastructure programme launched in February 2022 by NDRC, the Cyberspace Administration of China, MIIT and the National Energy Administration. It sets up eight national computing hubs (Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Greater Bay Area, Chengdu-Chongqing, Inner Mongolia, Guizhou, Gansu and Ningxia) and ten data centre clusters. Back-end and offline work moves to western hubs, while latency-sensitive services such as AI inference stay in eastern hubs. A December 2023 implementation opinion from NDRC, the National Data Administration and others extended it into a national integrated computing network. It targets over 60% of new computing capacity in hub regions by end-2025.
beneficiaries: Data centre operators and users of cloud and AI computing capacity
